**Prompt:** Create a clean, high-contrast line graph with a clearly labeled upward-sloping supply curve (P on the vertical axis for price, Q on the horizontal axis for quantity). Use bold, sans-serif labels and a solid blue line for the curve, with a light grid background for readability. Avoid any extraneous text or branding.

**Alt:** A line graph with an upward-sloping curve labeled 'Supply,' showing the relationship between price (P) and quantity (Q).

**Prompt:**

**Alt:** A line graph with an upward-sloping supply curve, labeled axes for price and quantity, and a blue trend line.
